adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `createEvent` now selects the calendar by matching `cal.credentialId === credentialId` and then calls `calendar.events.insert` with `calendarId: selectedCalendar || "primary"`. If `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar` does not contain an entry for that `credentialId` (e.g., stale/mismatched destinationCalendar data), `selectedCalendar` becomes `undefined` and the code will create the event on the Google account’s `primary` calendar (potentially the wrong calendar) instead of failing. This misrouting is a real behavioral risk introduced/exposed by the new array+credential matching logic. The diff also shows `CalendarManager.createEvent` continues to swallow 404s (`if (error?.code === 404) return undefined;`), which can hide misconfiguration; combined with the new fallback-to-primary, it can create events in an unintended calendar without surfacing an error.
